title: yesterday
summary: Step back through English and uncover two old time-word parts.
question: What is hiding inside yesterday?
completion: You traced yesterday through Middle English yesterdai to Old English geostran dæg, then uncovered geostran (yesterday) and dæg (day). German gestern is a cousin of the first part. The English word carries both old parts!
partner: Travel backwards through the word, then investigate both pieces.
